ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a right triangle, with the right-angle mark at point C; point B is on the upper left, point C is on the lower left, and point A is on the right. Then reason: The problem gives a=14, b=48, c=50, and asks for tan A. For angle A, the tangent value equals opposite side divided by adjacent side; the opposite side of angle A is BC, namely a, and the adjacent side is CA, namely b.
